title: Hanover Park and Newfields — simplified 2015 road geography
status: Original schematic of a small number of observed geographic facts. This is not survey GIS, a current street map, or exact building footprints.

source.title: Hanover Park Public Investment Framework
source.scope: The wider Safe Node study area includes Hanover Park and Newfields, excludes Mountain View, and is labelled 356 ha in Figure 1 (page 5). This is not the census suburb boundary.
source.reuse: Geographic facts selected and represented as original simplified linework. Do not copy or package source map artwork. Current municipal Open Data GIS service has not yet been downloaded.

coordinates.referenceScale: The source's printed 500 metre scale bar spans about 270 schematic units. Approximate distances only.

importantLimitations: These polylines preserve only major observed road relationships and curvature, with deliberate simplification.
The northern Surran segment stops where the observed path becomes ambiguous; this file does not invent a southern extension.
No flat/court names have been attached to unverified positions.
No current shop location or opening status has been established from this map.
No official geographic boundary, exact building footprint, current traffic layout, new MyCiTi works, or routing has been imported.
